paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Caption not extracted
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the distribution of polarity scores, representing the sentiment of vaccine-related data. The x-axis is labeled "Polarity scores," has a linear scale, and ranges from -1.1 to 0.6, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "Counts," has a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 8000, with tick labels at intervals of 2000. A single blue line with circular markers and a solid style represents the count of polarity scores, starting at approximately 100 counts at a polarity score of -1.1, remaining relatively stable until -0.6, then rising to around 500 counts at -0.5, dipping slightly to around 400 at -0.4, before increasing steadily to a peak of approximately 9200 counts at a polarity score of 0, followed by a sharp decline to around 2800 counts at 0.2, and then fluctuating between 0 and 2000 counts until the end of the x-axis at 0.6.
